desc:
🥷 Train, fight and climb to the top in Ninja Warriors!

⚔️ Swing your sword to build Ninjitsu, sell it for Coins, and buy stronger swords and belts.
🏝️ Multi-jump up to floating islands with better training spots.
🔮 Open 30+ crystals to hatch pets, then evolve them all the way to Immortal.
🌀 Unlock ranks and elements to become a true warrior.
🥊 Battle in PvP, win 1v1 duels, rule King of the Hill and take down the bosses.
🤝 Trade pets safely with full stats and a 5-second countdown on every trade.
✨ Show off with auras, trails and titles (looks only, never pay-to-win).

• Fair PvP: no one-shots or immortal players
• Anti-cheat: exploiters get banned
• Daily rewards and monthly leaderboards
• Full controller and console support

🎁 Use code RELEASE for free Coins!
👍 Like the game and join the group for bigger daily rewards and a free group chest!
